purpose: Independent temporal holdout after H.1.2 failed and April discovery identified alternative corner feeds.

discovery_data.polymarket_exclusion_reason: Different outcomeId query semantics and exchange-depth/liquidity requirements; retained for research only.

candidate_selection.eligible_book_rule: At least one half-point line in the competition/market discovery fixture with both Over and Under having >=1 timestamped snapshot.
candidate_selection.representative_rule: Within each correlation group, choose the slug with highest two-sided line count; tie -> highest target snapshot count; tie -> lexicographically smallest slug.
candidate_selection.group_ranking_rule: Rank group representatives by two-sided line count desc, target snapshot count desc, slug asc.
candidate_selection.zero_candidate_rule: If no candidate survives for a competition/market, pre-mark that contract FAIL_SOURCE_COVERAGE and do not improvise a replacement.

holdout.fixture_eligibility: All completed men's full-time fixtures in the target tournament with kickoff_utc inside the holdout window; postponed/cancelled/abandoned excluded by status, never by odds availability.

market_contract.pair_reconstruction: For each side independently, use the latest snapshot at or before prediction_as_of; both sides must be price>1, active is not False, timestamped, nonfuture, and each side age <=300 seconds.

gates.competition_market_pass: All three horizons PASS and at least one selected bookmaker admitted for the contract.

closing.definition: Last valid identical-contract two-sided state strictly before kickoff.

promotion.H_final_pass_requires: At least one competition/market contract PASS plus all infrastructure, temporal, raw-integrity, SQLite, test and restore gates PASS. Failed contracts remain explicitly out of domain.
